usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations, and Bolna places a call through your Bolna account when “New Registration” runs “Make a Phone Call”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A new registrant gets a call soon after signing up, instead of waiting for someone to dial.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” also fires, so one attendee could receive a second call from “Make a Phone Call”.
